critical_path_method: Requires request markers and dependencies; cumulative time is reported separately

cross_rank_alignment.status: Clock-aligned comparison requires profiler metadata establishing a common clock; rank spans retained separately

communication_export_summary.method: Counts distinct non-aggregate communication.json entries; HCCL phase/kernel counts are reported separately. Elapsed sums can overlap and are not critical-path duration

ranks.communication_size_scope: One preferred transport per call (SIO first); MB converted with 1024**2. SIO/SDMA aliases are not added. Values describe reported transit bytes; tensor payload interpretation depends on collective algorithm

module_flow_correlation.method: Explicit flow s/f endpoints: source lies within host marker and target within device kernel on its exact pid/tid
module_flow_correlation.scope: Module kernel totals include nested modules; totals across modules overlap and remain separate from request critical paths

memory.method: Peak recorded values per explicit component/device; component totals may overlap. Capture can omit earlier allocations and does not classify weights/cache by itself
memory.units: MB/KB retained exactly as labelled by exporter; verify exporter byte conversion before unit reinterpretation

methods.timing: Integer ns arithmetic; exported durations in us. Kernel sums, interval unions and host inclusive ranges remain distinct
methods.active_compute_unique: Only computation tasks compete for active-only unique coverage. Sync waits/records, HCCL parent ranges and communication AICPU are excluded; denominator is active compute union in the same collection
methods.modules: Means over request-associated marker instances; parent and child scopes overlap. Head active compute and upstream EVENT WAIT are separate
methods.critical_path: Explicit flow proves provenance. Unique coverage/removal upper bounds measure occupancy; full DAG critical-path improvement requires a follow-up experiment
methods.pipe_metrics: Kernel-duration-weighted reported ratios (0..1), plus exporter cube_utilization(%); full min/max/samples in remote summary
